item.title: Public Protector probe: DA's Aucamp accuses Dion George of state resource misuse
item.description: ​DA leader, John Steenhuisen, DA’s federal finance chairperson and former minister Dion George and Minister of Forestry, Fisheries and the Environment, Willie Aucamp. Tensions are escalating in the DA after Aucamp lodged a complaint against George with the Public Protector's office.

item.title: Cape Town court rules in favour of minstrel troupes, ensuring venue for cultural competition
item.description: A late-night High Court ruling has ordered the City of Cape Town to provide a suitable venue for minstrel troops, following an urgent application by the Cape Town Minstrel Carnival Association over withdrawn approvals and parade permits.

item.title: Cape Town hiker dies in hospital after tragic fall
item.description: Wilderness Search and Rescue (WSAR) teams were called to Muizenberg on Sunday morning following a serious fall near Bailey’s Kloof. A hiker fell several metres while scrambling above a trail and was found critically injured. Despite the best efforts of rescue and medical personnel, the hiker later died in hospital.

item.title: Police link recovered firearm to Atteridgeville tavern mass shooting following arrest
item.description: Forensic evidence has linked a firearm found on a suspect to the Atteridgeville mass shooting that left 12 people dead.
